# OpenMower OS boot config — Raspberry Pi 4 / CM4 (BCM2711), headless.

start_file=start4.elf
fixup_file=fixup4.dat

kernel=Image
arm_64bit=1

# Headless: minimal GPU memory, no rainbow splash
gpu_mem=16
disable_splash=1

# GPIO14/15 as a general-purpose UART (mini-UART, serial0/ttyS0) -- a real
# device is wired to it on the mower, not a debug terminal, so no console=
# on this port (cmdline-{a,b}.txt) and no getty. enable_uart=1 is still
# needed to fix the mini-UART's clock (otherwise it tracks the scaling ARM
# core frequency and the baud rate drifts) -- normally Bluetooth uses the
# better PL011 and disable-bt moves PL011 onto these pins instead (stock
# OpenMowerOS's reference config), but we deliberately do NOT disable
# Bluetooth here: improv-ble needs it for BLE wifi provisioning. uart2-5
# below already give four more independent hardware UARTs for LL board/
# xESC/GPS comms, so this isn't a capacity problem, just a (known, weaker
# than PL011) mini-UART for whatever's on GPIO14/15.
enable_uart=1

# Additional independent hardware UARTs (GPIO0/1, 4/5, 8/9, 12/13) for mower
# comms wiring (LL board, xESC boards, GPS) -- ported from OpenMowerOS.
dtoverlay=uart2
dtoverlay=uart3
dtoverlay=uart4
dtoverlay=uart5

# CM4 Wi-Fi antenna: internal/on-module (default). Overridable per-device
# without a rebuild/reflash -- see usercfg.txt below.
dtparam=ant1

# CM4 IO board fan control, if fitted (GPIO18, starts at 70C). Commented by
# default like OpenMowerOS's own reference config -- not every carrier board
# has one wired.
#dtoverlay=pwm-gpio-fan,fan_gpio=18,temp=70000

# Per-device local overrides (antenna selection, etc.) that survive OS
# updates -- config.txt itself is baked into every image/bundle and
# overwritten wholesale on each update, but usercfg.txt is synced onto the
# active boot partition from /data at runtime instead (see
# openmower-sync-bootcfg, rauc-hook.sh, and usercfg.txt.default's own
# comments for how to edit it). A missing include target is silently
# ignored by the Pi firmware -- fine for e.g. the very first boot before
# openmower-sync-bootcfg has run for the first time.
include usercfg.txt
